k-sym-DCTY.title: GTA 6 AudaCity $DCTY coins
k-sym-DCTY.sourceSays: Posts say a $DCTY token tied to GTA VI's in-game crypto app and 'AudaCity' trucks launched Nov 18; one post says the truck video was edited and is fake.
k-sym-DCTY.reason: Posts of Nov 18-20 describe a GTA 6 lore meme (AudaCity, ticker DCTY) with a disputed truck video; the scouted pools are 0.4h-old copies of a coin that began Nov 18.
